text: concept years potential life lost (YPLL) involves estimating average time person lived died prematurely (Gardner Sanborn, 1990). Denoting number deaths \(\)-th age group \(d_i\), YPLL can estimated $$YPLL = \sum_{=1}^{K^*} a_i d_i$$ \(K^*\) number age groups 0 K, \(a_i\) difference K midpoint age age group, assuming uniform distribution deaths group, K standard age death. midpoint age group estimated (lowest age + highest age + 1)/2. Different authors use different values K. According Bruce et al. (2018), historically, used life expectancy Japan, highest world. authors uses 75 years reference age approximates US life expectancy (Ma et al., 2015).
